# VIIPER standalone server

The unmodified `viiper-windows-amd64.exe` is from [VIIPER 0.9.0](https://github.com/Alia5/VIIPER/releases/tag/v0.9.0). Its SHA-256 is `142c144f6abee8b8a5f6a1abbc7018683444de71d2e45102cde6aaab9b2223e6`. The file had a valid Authenticode signature from Peter Repukat during verification on 2026-11-17.

The server is GPL-3.0 licensed. This directory includes its [license](LICENSE.txt) and the corresponding [source archive](source-v0.9.0.zip). PadBridge starts it as a separate localhost process through the MIT-licensed `viiper-client` crate.
